about_short_description.short_description: Codes Health specializes in automated collection of medical records, gathering data from exchanges, providers, and patients.

product.name: Automated Medical Record Collection
product.description: A system that automatically collects patient medical records from health information exchanges, external providers, and patients themselves.

identifier.value: Digital Intake and Release of Information (ROI)

product.name: Digital Intake and Release of Information (ROI)
product.description: A digital tool that enables patients to complete medical release of information forms accurately via phone or browser.

product.name: Provider Verification
product.description: A service that verifies listed healthcare providers against a provider database to correct common entry errors.

product.name: Fax Number Lookup
product.description: A service that identifies the correct fax numbers for healthcare providers after patient release of information is signed.

product.name: Custom Service Type Requirements Verification
product.description: A feature that verifies patient eligibility for care based on custom intake or service requirements set by providers.

product.name: Automated Provider Follow-ups
product.description: A system that automatically contacts unresponsive providers via calls and emails to obtain medical records.
